{
  "openapi": "3.0.2",
  "info": {
    "title": "文档访问",
    "version": "7.0.0",
    "description": "API to access AnyShare\r\n\r\n如有任何疑问，可到开发者社区提问：https://developers.aishu.cn\r\n# Authentication\r\n- 调用需要鉴权的API，必须将token放在HTTP header中：\"Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN\"\r\n- 对于GET请求，除了将token放在HTTP header中，也可以将token放在URL query string中：\"tokenid=ACCESS_TOKEN\"\r\n",
    "contact": {},
    "x-logo": {
      "url": "data:image/png;base64,",
      "backgroundColor": "#FFFFFF",
      "altText": "AnyShare logo"
    }
  },
  "servers": [
    {
      "url": "https://{host}:{port}/api",
      "description": "host: AnyShare服务器IP, port: 默认端口443",
      "variables": {
        "host": {
          "default": "host",
          "description": "AnyShare服务器IP"
        },
        "port": {
          "default": "443",
          "description": "https默认端口443"
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "paths": {
    "/efast/v1/entry-doc-lib": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "入口文档库"
        ],
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "type",
            "description": "文档库类型。不传时获取所有类型文档库\r\n- user_doc_lib：个人文档库 \r\n- department_doc_lib：部门文档库 \r\n- custom_doc_lib：自定义文档库\r\n- shared_user_doc_lib: 共享个人文档库\r\n- knowledge_doc_lib: 知识库",
            "schema": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "enum": [
                  "user_doc_lib",
                  "department_doc_lib",
                  "custom_doc_lib",
                  "shared_user_doc_lib",
                  "knowledge_doc_lib"
                ],
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "in": "query",
            "required": false
          },
          {
            "name": "sort",
            "description": "排序类型。不传时默认为doc_lib_name\n- doc_lib_name：文档库名称\n- date_modified：修改时间",
            "schema": {
              "enum": [
                "doc_lib_name",
                "date_modified"
              ],
              "type": "string"
            },
            "in": "query"
          },
          {
            "name": "direction",
            "description": "排序结果方向。不传时默认为asc\n- asc：升序\n- desc：降序",
            "schema": {
              "enum": [
                "asc",
                "desc"
              ],
              "type": "string"
            },
            "in": "query"
          },
          {
            "name": "subtype_id",
            "description": "文档库分类id。不传时不以文档库分类对文档库进行筛选。\r\n当前仅个人文档库有文档库分类",
            "schema": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "in": "query",
            "required": false
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "$ref": "#/components/schemas/EntryDoc"
                  }
                }
              }
            },
            "description": "接口调用成功"
          },
          "400": {
            "$ref": "#/components/responses/RespStd400"
          },
          "401": {
            "$ref": "#/components/responses/RespStd401"
          },
          "403": {
            "$ref": "#/components/responses/RespStd403"
          },
          "500": {
            "$ref": "#/components/responses/RespStd500"
          }
        },
        "summary": "获取文档库信息",
        "description": "根据QUERY PARAMETERS参数获取相应类型的文档库的信息。"
      }
    },

    "/efast/v1/file/osdownload": {
      "post": {
        "requestBody": {
          "description": "",
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/fileOsdownloadReq"
              }
            }
          },
          "required": true
        },
        "tags": [
          "文件上传下载"
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/fileOsdownloadRes"
                }
              }
            },
            "description": "接口调用成功"
          },
          "400": {
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Error"
                }
              }
            },
            "description": "接口调用失败，HTTP状态码可能为4xx、5xx，具体参见错误码说明章节"
          }
        },
        "summary": "下载文件协议",
        "description": "1. 收到请求响应时，客户端自行向对象存储发送下载文件内容的请求\r\n2. 如果authtype为空，则按照下面的方式下载，15分钟内发送GET请求\r\nURL为：https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/anyshares3accesstestbucket/21A9B9FD1B524CB49D54BF7399F82EB4/AAA6CBAFE45B4E4D884DC59805E60A5C\r\nHeader包含：\r\n“Authorization: AWS AKIAJEROARV2UTTADY6A:PkLXjvYrDGDVZgTD8WVbMmS33q4=”\r\n“Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2015 02:35:36 GMT”\r\nBody为：空\r\n3. 如果authtype为QUERY_STRING，则按照下面的方式下载，15分钟内发送GET请求\r\nURL为：https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/anyshares3accesstestbucket/21A9B9FD1B524CB49D54BF7399F82EB4/AAA6CBAFE45B4E4D884DC59805E60A5C?AWSAccessKeyId=AKIAJEROARV2UTTADY6A&Expires=1428384700&Signature=lnOy3CUh9KNknNDX8aB8Mhur7%2Bw%3D\r\n4. 如果想分块下载，请自行在Header中加入Range\r\n5. 发送GET请求后，可能并不能直接获取数据，将获得 HTTP/1.1 307 Temporary Redirect，此时重定向的数据实际下载地址包含在返回的header中，形如：\r\nLocation: http://iovip.qbox.me/file/8QhbPDcKueO0ZOEDqnroKw0y478TNADQAwAAACfQem72ulBu9rl6bvYDEHDiumoeFLDnJKS5em72uXpu9rl6bvbWRi-vul_Q0Ckfu5f7PMvE9OoXIdfQ0NDT-tDQ0NDQ0N2pQCrK0NDQcHNHYPbupfOQx9EUBTS5bh6sR1Jtqr4maaq-JmmqviY=\r\n对于重定向的情况，客户端需要判断并从新地址下载数据，以C++开发使用curl为例，需要设置：curl_easy_setopt (_curl, CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION, 1); "
      }
    },

        "requestBody": {

              "schema": {

              "examples": {

                  "summary": "创建文件，传参为目录gns，name参数为文件名",

                    "client_mtime": 1380245084296354,

        "responses": {

      }
    },

        "summary": "上传大文件的分块协议",
        "description": "1. 收到该响应后，客户端自行发送文件分片内容的请求到对象存储。\r\n2. 客户端在请求Header中填入authrequests中的header，15分钟内发送PUT请求\r\n\r\n    示例：\r\n\r\n    URL：https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/anyshares3accesstestbucket/21A9B9FD1B524CB49D54BF7399F82EB4/AAA6CBAFE45B4E4D884DC59805E60A5C?partNumber=1&uploadId=0004B9895DBBB6EC98E36\r\n    \r\n    Header：\r\n    ```\r\n    “Authorization: AWS AKIAJEROARV2UTTADY6A:PkLXjvYrDGDVZgTD8WVbMmS33q4=”\r\n    “Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2015 02:35:36 GMT”\r\n    “Content-Length: 42”\r\n    ```\r\n    \r\n    Body：分片内容\r\n3. 对象存储返回响应信息时，响应header中可能包含Etag值，用于标识所上传对象分片。如果存在key为ETag/ETAG/etag/Etag等值的header，需要取得其对应的值(如果这些header都没有，直接使用空字符串)，作为完成大文件分块上传协议oscompleteupload的传参，见参数partetag及请求示例。\r\n    \r\n    需注意，不同对象存储返回的Etag的header，key大小写可能不同，可能为ETag/ETAG/etag/Etag等(如果这些header都没有，直接使用空字符串)。可以对响应header进行遍历，对每个key转为小写，和字符串“etag”对比，获取对应的值。一个可能的响应header示例为：Etag: ce1c8d1c3900c64feaa651052d75acd9\r\n\r\n4. 亚马逊S3限定分块大小不能小于5MB，七牛存储限定分块大小为4M的倍数。见“对象存储选项值协议”说明"
      }
    },

    "/efast/v1/file/thumbnail": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "文件协议（操作相关）"
        ],
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "docid",
            "description": "文件gns路径（列举协议返回）",
            "schema": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "in": "query",
            "required": true
          },
          {
            "name": "rev",
            "description": "版本号，为空默认获取最新版本。",
            "schema": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "in": "query",
            "required": false
          },
          {
            "name": "height",
            "description": "缩略图的高度",
            "schema": {
              "format": "int64",
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "in": "query",
            "required": true
          },
          {
            "name": "width",
            "description": "缩略图的宽度",
            "schema": {
              "format": "int64",
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "in": "query",
            "required": true
          },
          {
            "name": "quality",
            "description": "缩略图质量，默认为75",
            "schema": {
              "format": "int64",
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "in": "query"
          },
          {
            "name": "tokenid",
            "description": "鉴权",
            "schema": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "in": "query",
            "required": true
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "content": {
              "image/*": {
                "schema": {
                  "format": "binary",
                  "type": "string"
                }
              }
            },
            "description": "接口调用成功"
          },
          "400": {
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Error"
                }
              }
            },
            "description": "接口调用失败，HTTP状态码可能为4xx、5xx，具体参见错误码说明章节"
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {}
        ],
        "summary": "图片缩略图协议",
        "description": "1. 缩略后的图片以传入的大小按比例缩放，而非拉伸处理。\r\n2. 图片的大小如果小于等于传入的大小，不做缩放处理，仅做质量处理。\r\n3. 目前支持的格式为：bmp、jpg、png、gif、tif。\r\n4. 默认支持对大小小于等于20M的图片进行缩略。\r\n5. tif格式的缩略图为jpg格式用于Web展示，其他为原始格式。\r\n"
      }
    },

    "/user-management/v1/search-in-group": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "用户组查询"
        ],
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "keyword",
            "description": "搜索内容。即用户组名或者成员名",
            "schema": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "in": "query",
            "required": true
          },
          {
            "name": "type",
            "description": "搜索信息类型：\n- `member` 搜索成员信息\n- `group` 搜索用户组信息\n",
            "schema": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "enum": [
                  "member",
                  "group"
                ],
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "in": "query",
            "required": true
          },
          {
            "name": "offset",
            "description": "获取数据起始下标",
            "schema": {
              "format": "int64",
              "default": 0,
              "minimum": 0,
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "in": "query",
            "required": false
          },
          {
            "name": "limit",
            "description": "获取数据量",
            "schema": {
              "format": "int64",
              "default": 20,
              "maximum": 1000,
              "minimum": 1,
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "in": "query",
            "required": false
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {

    "/api/efast/v1/folders/{id}/sub_objects": {

      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "目录协议"
        ],
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "limit",

            "schema": {
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "in": "query",
            "required": true
          },
          {
            "examples": {
              "example1": {
                "value": "4oCcbmFtZTEsMjFBOUI5RkQxQjUyNENCNDlENTRCRjczOTlGODJFQjQsZGly4oCd"
              }
            },
            "name": "marker",
            "description": "分页标记，由上次调用该接口成功后返回。首次调用不传",
            "schema": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "in": "query",
            "required": false
          },
          {
            "name": "sort",
            "description": "第一次调用时可传，后续调用不传。指定按哪个字段排序(若不指定，默认按id升序排序): \n- name, 按文件名称排序\n- size，按大小排序\n- time，按服务器修改时间排序",
            "schema": {
              "enum": [
                "name",
                "size",
                "time"
              ],
              "type": "string"
            },
            "in": "query"
          },
          {
            "name": "direction",
            "description": "第一次调用时可传，后续调用不传，默认为升序\n- asc，升序\n- desc，降序",
            "schema": {
              "enum": [
                "asc",
                "desc"
              ],
              "type": "string"
            },
            "in": "query"
          },
          {
            "name": "id",
            "description": "目录gns（支持文档库gns）",
            "schema": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "in": "path",
            "required": true
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ListResponses"
                }
              }
            },
            "description": "接口调用成功"
          },

          },

          },

            "$ref": "#/components/responses/RespStd404"
          },
          "500": {
            "$ref": "#/components/responses/RespStd500"
          }
        },
        "description": "分页列举目录协议"
      }

      "fileOsbeginuploadReq": {
        "description": "",
        "required": [
          "docid",
          "length"
        ],
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "docid": {
            "description": "gns（全局名字空间）路径，创建或者列举协议返回\r\n- 创建文件时， gns为待创建文件的父目录gns；\r\n- 编辑文件时（文件生成新版本），gns为所编辑文件的gns",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "length": {
            "format": "int64",
            "description": "整个文件的长度，支持最大5G",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "name": {
            "description": "文件名称，UTF8编码\r\n- 创建文件时， name为文件名；\r\n- 编辑文件时（文件生成新版本），参数为空\r\n",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "client_mtime": {
            "format": "int64",
            "description": "由客户端设置的文件本地修改时间\r\n创建新版本（rev为空或name为为空）时，写入版本",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "ondup": {
            "format": "int64",
            "description": "当name不为空时生效\r\n- 1:检查是否重命名，重名则抛异常\r\n- 2:如果重名冲突，自动重名\r\n- 3:如果重名冲突，自动覆盖\r\n",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "reqmethod": {
            "description": "向存储服务器上传数据时的请求方法。\r\n默认为“PUT”；参数值“POST”表示使用POST表单的方式上传\r\n",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "csflevel": {
            "format": "int64",
            "description": "文件密级预检查，要设置密级必须在osendupload中设置\r\n- 0：默认值，不检查密级\r\n- 5~15：正常密级\r\n- 0x7FFF：空密级\r\n",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "editedrev": {
            "description": "表示编辑文件时，基于文件的哪个版本（版本ID）进行编辑，默认为空。\r\n- 如果为空，不检查是否基于文件的最新版本进行编辑；\r\n- 如果不为空，若所编辑的版本ID不是服务器上文件的最新版本，则上传报错。错误码403203，“所编辑文件的版本与服务端文件最新版本不一致”\r\n",
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      },

            "description": "文件名称，UTF8编码\r\n- 创建文件时， name为文件名；\r\n- 编辑文件时（文件生成新版本），参数为空；\r\n",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "client_mtime": {
            "format": "int64",
            "description": "由客户端设置的文件本地修改时间\r\n\r\n创建新版本（rev为空或name为为空）时，写入版本\r\n",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "ondup": {
            "format": "int64",
            "description": "当name不为空时生效\r\n- 1:检查是否重命名，重名则抛异常\r\n- 2:如果重名冲突，自动重名\r\n- 3:如果重名冲突，自动覆盖\r\n",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "csflevel": {
            "format": "int64",
            "description": "文件密级预检查，要设置密级必须在osendupload中设置\r\n- 0：默认值，不检查密级\r\n- 5~15：正常密级\r\n- 0x7FFF：空密级\r\n",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "editedrev": {
            "description": "表示编辑文件时，基于文件的哪个版本（版本ID）进行编辑，默认为空。\r\n- 如果为空，不检查是否基于文件的最新版本进行编辑；\r\n- 如果不为空，若所编辑的版本ID不是服务器上文件的最新版本，则上传报错。错误码403203，“所编辑文件的版本与服务端文件最新版本不一致”；\r\n",
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      },

            "description": "防泄密配置\r\n0表示不允许打印，也不允许拷屏\r\n1表示允许打印\r\n2表示允许拷屏\r\n3表示允许打印/拷屏",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "pwdcontrol": {
            "format": "int64",
            "description": "是否开启管控密码\r\n1 表示开启\r\n0 表示关闭",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "usertype": {
            "format": "int64",
            "description": "用户类型\r\n1 表示本地用户\r\n2 表示域用户\r\n3 表示第三方认证用户",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "directdepinfos": {
            "description": "用户的多个直属部门信息",
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "$ref": "#/components/schemas/userGetResDirectdeptinfo"
            }
          },
          "needsecondauth": {
            "description": "是否需要二次认证",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "freezestatus": {
            "description": "冻结状态\ntrue：冻结\nfalse：未冻结",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "agreedtotermsofuse": {
            "description": "同意使用协议状态\ntrue：同意 \nfalse：未同意",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "ismanager": {
            "description": "是否为组织管理员",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "telnumber": {
            "description": "用户手机号",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "needrealnameauth": {
            "description": "用户是否需实名认证 true：需要 false : 不需要",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "roletypes": {
            "description": "所属角色，整数数组，每个整数表示不同的角色\r\n1：表示文档审核员\r\n[1]",
            "type": "array",
            "items": {

          "sizecopied": {
            "format": "int64",

          },
          "filecopying": {
            "description": "如果查询成功，返回正在复制的文件名",

            "description": "如果查询成功，返回复制源位置的父目录名称，如果为根目录，返回空",

          },
          "destination": {
            "description": "如果查询成功，返回复制目标父目录的名称",

      "messageGetResMsgBase": {
        "description": "",
        "required": [
          "id",
          "type",
          "sender",
          "accessorname",
          "accessortype",
          "time",
          "url",
          "isdir",
          "isread",
          "csf"
        ],
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "accessorname": {
            "description": "接收者名字，如果是匿名共享，为空字符串",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "accessortype": {
            "description": "表示访问者类型",
            "enum": [
              "user",
              "department",
              "contactor"
            ],
            "type": "string"
          },
          "csf": {
            "format": "int64",
            "description": "文件密级，5~15，文件夹为0",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "id": {
            "description": "此条消息的唯一标识",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "isdir": {
            "description": "是否为文件夹",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "isread": {
            "description": "消息是否已读",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "sender": {
            "description": "发送者名字",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "time": {
            "format": "int64",
            "description": "共享操作的时间(unix utc ns)",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "type": {
            "format": "int64",
            "description": "此条消息的类型\r\n1. 开启实名共享\r\n2. 关闭实名共享\r\n3. 设置所有者\r\n4. 取消所有者\r\n5. 开启实名共享申请\r\n6. 关闭实名共享申请\r\n7. 设置所有者申请\r\n8. 取消所有者申请\r\n9. 开启匿名共享申请\r\n10. 开启实名共享审核结果\r\n11. 关闭实名共享审核结果\r\n12. 开启所有者审核结果\r\n13. 关闭所有者审核结果\r\n14. 开启匿名共享审核结果\r\n15. 待审流程消息\r\n16. 流程进度消息 \r\n17. 流程结果消息\r\n18. 简单消息\r\n19. 提交密级申请消息\r\n20. 密级申请审核结果\r\n21. 隔离消息\r\n22. 隔离被还原消息\r\n23. 杀毒消息\r\n24. 创建文档收集任务消息\r\n25. 文档收发变更消息\r\n26. 文档收发提醒消息\r\n27. 取消文档收发任务消息\r\n28. 文件到期通知消息\r\n29. 短信验证码发送\r\n30. 继承变更申请消息\r\n31. 继承变更审核结果\r\n32. 申诉被通过消息\r\n33. 申诉被否决消息",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "url": {
            "description": "实名共享，相对地址",
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "example": {
          "accessorname": "用户1",
          "accessortype": "department",
          "csf": 5,
          "end": 1449991042578000,
          "id": "aa7878cf-90ad-4db4-a3bd-051d07b2f280",
          "isdir": false,
          "isread": false,
          "allowvalue": 71,
          "denyvalue": 0,
          "sender": "用户2",
          "time": 1447254972466688,
          "type": 1,
          "url": "测试文档库/abc.txt"
        }
      },

          "cadpreview": {
            "description": "是否启用CAD预览服务",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "clearcache": {
            "description": "客户端退出时，是否强制清除缓存",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "clientlogouttime": {
            "format": "int64",
            "description": "客户端超时退出时间，单位为分钟\r\n-1表示不开启超时退出\r\n其它值表示多少分钟后退出\r\n例如30表示30分钟超时后退出",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "defaultpermexpireddays": {
            "format": "int64",
            "description": "客户端配置权限时，默认权限有效天数\r\n-1为无限期",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "enableclientmanuallogin": {
            "description": "是否允许AnyShare客户端手动登录",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "enablecsflevel": {
            "description": "是否开启更改密级审核\r\ntrue表示开启\r\nfalse表示关闭",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "enablefiletransferlimit": {
            "description": "是否开启文件传输限制功能",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "enablehttplinkaudit": {
            "description": "是否开启http共享审核\r\ntrue表示开启\r\nfalse表示关闭",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "enableonedrive": {
            "description": "是否启用onedrive跳转，默认为false",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "enableshareaudit": {
            "description": "是否开启共享审核\r\ntrue表示开启\r\nfalse表示关闭",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "enableuseragreement": {
            "description": "是否显示用户协议，默认为false",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "hidecachesetting": {
            "description": "客户端是否隐藏缓存设置",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "indefiniteperm": {
            "description": "权限配置，截至时间是否支持无限期",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "maxpassexpireddays": {
            "format": "int64",
            "description": "密码配置，密码允许的最大过期天数\r\n-1为永久",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "owasurl": {
            "description": "OWAS的预览url，如果未配置则为空字符串",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "rememberpass": {
            "description": "登录配置，是否允许记住用户名和密码",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "sursenpreview": {
            "description": "是否开启gd/sep预览",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "wopiurl": {
            "description": "WOPI的url，如果未配置则为空字符串",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "cadtool": {
            "description": "配置的转换服务类型，cadpreview为true时返回\n\"mx\"为梦想CAD\n\"hc\"为浩辰CAD",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "cadurl": {
            "description": "CAD服务器地址\ncadpreview为true，且cadtool为\"hc\"时返回",
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "example": {
          "allowauthlowcsfuser": true,
          "allowowner": true,
          "cadpreview": false,
          "clearcache": false,
          "clientlogouttime": -1,
          "defaultpermexpireddays": -1,
          "enableclientmanuallogin": true,
          "enablecsflevel": false,
          "enablefiletransferlimit": false,
          "enablehttplinkaudit": false,
          "enableonedrive": false,
          "enableshareaudit": false,
          "enableuseragreement": false,
          "hidecachesetting": false,
          "indefiniteperm": true,
          "maxpassexpireddays": -1,
          "owasurl": "",
          "rememberpass": true,
          "sursenpreview": false,
          "wopiurl": ""
        }

            "type": "boolean"
          },

            "description": "是否启用消息通知功能",
            "type": "boolean"

    {
      "name": "文件上传下载",
      "description": "**文件上传流程**\r\n\r\n文件上传分为两种，分别为单次上传文件和分块上传文件。其中，单块上传文件最大支持上传5G的文件。需要上传大于5G的文件时，必须采用分块上传的流程。\r\n\r\n建议内网环境文件大于100M时，或者外网环境采用分块上传。作为参考值，可以选用4M大小的文件分块，即将文件分成4M的数据块分别上传，最终组成一个完整的文件，最后一块的大小可以是分块时余下的文件大小，不作其它限制。\r\n\r\n**单次上传文件流程：**\r\n\r\n![signle-upload-flow][signle-upload-flow]\r\n\r\n1. 需要调用协议 osbeginupload和osendupload。\r\n\r\n2. 由osbeginupload协议返回的鉴权request，向对象存储服务发送数据的方法，请参考osbeginupload的请求返回示例和说明。\r\n\r\n**分块上传文件流程：**\r\n\r\n![multi-upload-flow][multi-upload-flow]\r\n\r\n1. 需要调用协议osinitmultiupload、osuploadpart、oscompleteupload和osendupload。\r\n\r\n2. 由osuploadpart（oscompleteupload）协议返回的鉴权request，向对象存储服务发送数据（索引文件）的方法，请参考osbeginupload的请求返回示例和说明。\r\n\r\n**对象存储差异说明**\r\n\r\n文档云可对接使用不同的对象存储，各个对象存储的请求处理响应存在一些差异，需客户端对接时注意，主要包括： \r\n\r\n1. 不同对象存储分块上传的分块大小和块数，可能不同。分块上传前，需调用osoption协议，获取对象存储分块选项值。只要云盘使用的对象存储没有变更，该协议的返回值不变，无需重复调用。客户端可将该协议的返回值，参数化到上传逻辑中，用于确定分块大小及块数。\r\n\r\n2. 上传对象到对象存储成功，包括单次上传对象成功，和上传文件分块成功，各个对象存储返回的HTTP状态码可能不同，比如返回200或201。可以认为：只要上传、下载请求的对象存储响应HTTP状态码在[200，299]之间，都认为请求成功。\r\n\r\n3. 分块上传时，先上传文件各个分块，再上传由分块信息组成的索引文件，以此在对象存储中组成一个完整文件。分块信息一般包括分块大小，以及对象存储在分块上传成功时返回的响应header中，Etag/ETAG/ETag/etag的值(如果这些header都没有，直接使用空字符串)。其差异和处理方式，详见**上传大文件分块协议**的说明。\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n[signle-upload-flow]: data:image/png;base64,\r\n[multi-upload-flow]: data:image/png;base64,"
    },
